subject.title: fix(codex): heartbeat notifications to other channels are silently denied by cross-context policy

question: Should heartbeat, cron, and inter-session Codex turns carried on the internal WebChat marker remain unbound from cross-provider containment while genuine WebChat user turns stay bound?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish restored delivery with the user-turn control preserved, but the permanent trust classification for autonomous and inter-session turns should be confirmed by the runtime owner.

options.title: Confirm the narrow restoration
options.body: Approve the three internal turn classes as non-conversation metadata and land the scoped resolver after refreshing the branch.

options.title: Keep inter-session bound
options.body: Narrow the exemption to heartbeat and cron if injected inter-session prompts must inherit an originating trust context.

options.title: Retain fail-closed behavior
options.body: Decline the PR only if cross-provider autonomous delivery is no longer supported and the documented workflow will be changed accordingly.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow restoration
recommendation.body: Approve the three internal turn classes as non-conversation metadata and land the scoped resolver after refreshing the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest history signal is the v2026.6.9 internal-turn Codex work that introduced the affected binding path.
